body: Integration-owner rule (Opus2, 2026-11-11, my own miss on 03d4's e6b8 run test-9582e4c2, 45/0/1 but recorded as unclassified_stages): in a GO-CARGO for a REGISTERED Central focused run that should earn verification credit, run cargo test DIRECTLY after `--`, as `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- cargo test -j 2 --bin termal -- <filters> --test-threads=2`, and give it repo-local TEMP/TMP/TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP outside the inspected worktree through the environment. Do NOT prefix `node scripts/test-temp-root.mjs`. The focused classifier (src/engram_verification_record.rs, engram_verification_record_check_kind -> engram_is_test_command) does not unwrap that wrapper, so the stage stays unclassified and no verification record is sent. The wrapper is fine in hostless DL560/Mac author jobs, which earn no credit anyway, and inside the full gate, whose rust-tests stage is recognized by stage name.
